title: Hot Air Balloon Safari Over the Serengeti
excerpt: Floating over the Serengeti at sunrise is a highlight for many travellers. How a balloon safari works and whether it is worth it for you.
body:
A hot air balloon flight over the Serengeti is one of the most memorable experiences in Tanzania. You see the plains wake up from above, in silence.

## How it works

- Pick-up from your lodge or camp very early, often around 05:00.
- Take-off at sunrise, after the balloon is inflated.
- About one hour in the air, drifting with the wind at different heights.
- Landing on the plains, followed by a bush breakfast, often with sparkling wine.
- A game drive back to camp.

## Where

Balloon flights operate in central Serengeti (Seronera), and in some seasons in the south and north.

## What you see

Herds, hippos in rivers, giraffes from above and the long shadows of the morning. Wildlife sightings depend on the season and wind direction.

## Is it safe?

Operators are licensed and pilots are experienced. Flights do not take off in bad weather.

## Things to know

- There is usually a weight limit and a minimum age.
- The basket can be shared with others.
- The flight is not suitable for people who are pregnant or have certain back problems.
- It is a paid add-on; book well in advance in high season.

## Worth it?

If it fits your budget, most travellers say yes. It is a special way to start a day. [Add a balloon flight to your safari](/travel-proposal/).
